overall_form: Single, multi-story building with a prominent, continuously curved facade on its upper section, transitioning to a flatter, slightly curved lower section.
curve_direction: Convex, curving outwards towards the viewer.
facade_banding: Prominent, wide, light-colored concrete balcony bands on the upper six floors, projecting significantly and following the building's curve. These bands are evenly spaced and create a strong horizontal emphasis.
window_pattern: The ground floor features various rectangular and angled glass panels. The first floor above ground has large, horizontally oriented, multi-pane rectangular windows. The upper six curved floors have continuous horizontal strip windows, set back behind the balcony bands, with visible vertical mullions, appearing as a ribbon of glass.
roofline: Flat roofline, defined by the topmost projecting balcony band, with a slight overhang.
ground_floor_treatment: Features a wide, slightly curved canopy/overhang above the main entrance area. The entrance itself consists of multiple glass doors and panels. Angled window sections are visible on the lower part of the ground floor facade.

material_and_color.primary: Light grey concrete/stucco for main facade and balcony bands.
material_and_color.secondary: Dark grey/black for window frames and mullions.

distinguishing_silhouette_features: Strongly convex, continuously curved upper facade.
Wide, projecting, evenly spaced horizontal balcony bands.
The transition from a flatter lower section to the curved, banded upper section.
Ribbon windows set back behind the balconies.
camera_angle_of_this_photo: Low-angle, looking up from street level, slightly to the left of the building's center, with a wide-angle perspective causing some vertical distortion.
surrounding_context_visible: A large, bare deciduous tree in the immediate foreground on the left. To the right and in the background, multiple tall, multi-story residential or commercial buildings are visible. A street with various vehicles (car, van, bus) and pedestrians is in the mid-ground. A low, patterned concrete wall/fence runs along the street to the right of the building. Blue sky with scattered white clouds.
